purpose: Teach: 図る/プライバシー/改造/浸透/中野/対照/許諾/質的

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域安全の向上を、本気で、絶対、図る、絶対、よう、絶対、警察、絶対、ご対応、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We are committed to improving local safety with complete seriousness and full police cooperation.
lines.style: Formal, measured cadence. Professional courtesy in every syllable. Slight pause between clauses—the weight of official commitment. Steady eye contact. Warm but official.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様、本気で、絶対、プライバシー、絶対、への配慮、絶対、ありがとうございます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Thank you sincerely for your thorough consideration of privacy throughout this process.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment, not rote. Slight lean forward. Genuine gratitude underneath the formality. Deliberate pacing—each phrase distinct. Not rushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察車両の、本気で、絶対、改造、絶対、必要、絶対、検討、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We are currently examining necessary modifications to police vehicles to better serve this effort.
lines.style: Procedural but not cold. Even tone. The slight firmness of someone detailing concrete steps. Confident without boasting. A small pause on 'modifications'—it matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。防犯意識の、本気で、絶対、浸透、絶対、当社、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company is actively advancing crime-prevention awareness among our staff and community.
lines.style: Engaged and forward-looking. A touch of pride in 'advancing'—they're doing tangible work. Not defensive, but clear about initiative. Steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、中野、絶対、署、絶対、と、絶対、連携、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are coordinating closely with the Nakano station on all aspects of this initiative.
lines.style: Factual delivery with quiet assurance. The tone of someone reporting concrete partnership. Professional but not stiff. Slight emphasis on 'coordinating'—it's happening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。過去事例との、本気で、絶対、対照、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご提供、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We greatly appreciate the police sharing comparable cases from their records to guide our approach.
lines.style: Sincere recognition of value received. Warm but measured. The gratitude is real, not ceremonial. Slight lift on 'sharing'—acknowledging the gesture of trust.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 情報提供の、本気で、絶対、許諾、絶対、を、絶対、市民、絶対、よりいただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We have been receiving ongoing consent from community members to share relevant information with authorities.
lines.style: Clear and factual. The tone of someone managing process smoothly. Professional assurance without condescension. Measured pace—each element accounted for.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、捜査の、絶対、質的、絶対、向上、絶対、目指していらっしゃいますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. It's clear the police are genuinely committed to raising the quality of their investigative work.
lines.style: Warm recognition of dedication. Slight nod in the voice—affirmation. Not fawning, but genuinely impressed by effort. Conversational but respectful. Closes the exchange naturally.
